name: Plenum

adaptedFrom.name: jekyll-theme-conference
adaptedFrom.author: Digitale Gesellschaft
reused: The multi day programme as a time grid: time down the left, rooms across the top, each session placed by its start time and spanning its duration (_layouts/program.html)
Switching between days over one grid, with the first day shown on load (the day tabs in _layouts/program.html)
The track as a colour carried on the left edge of every session, with a track key printed under the grid (_includes/get_track_properties.html and the legend block of _layouts/program.html)
The set of page types a congress needs: programme, talk, speaker index, room and location (_layouts/talk.html, speaker-overview.html, room.html, location.html)
The talk page shape: track and time tags above the title, the description, and a facts list beside it (_layouts/talk.html, _includes/show_talk_info.html)
One schedule data file that the whole grid is generated from (_data/program.yml), rebuilt here as tools/programme-data.json with tools/build-programme.mjs
notReused: Jekyll, Liquid, the gem packaging, npm and the Vite build
Bootstrap 5, its colour and spacing utilities and the Bootstrap icon set: the whole visual surface was rewritten
The upstream HTML table grid, replaced by a CSS grid that collapses into a chronological list on a narrow screen
The Leaflet map and its tile requests on the location page, replaced by two SVG drawings written here
The dark mode switch, the live indication, the stream modal, the progressive web app layer and the service worker
The JSON-LD schema layer, the Open Graph and Twitter card generation and the info box
Every line of upstream copy, its demo schedule and its screenshot

images.origin: Authored for this edition: the house mark, three days of a schedule drawn as stacked colour blocks against a ruled time gutter with a break bar across the foot
Authored for this edition: the Ground track mark, a solid ruled block on a baseline
Authored for this edition: the Bench track mark, a work surface on two legs with three tools laid out above it
Authored for this edition: the Floor track mark, seven filled circles in a dashed ring around an empty centre

Authored for this edition: the plan of the illustrative venue, six spaces around a hatched courtyard with one entrance and a stair run. It carries no text, so every room name stays editable HTML on the venue page; each space carries a shape that repeats as a CSS key in the room list

Authored for this edition: the drawn approach, a station, one street, a tram stop, a dashed walking route and the building beside a band of water. It replaces the Leaflet map on the upstream location page

photography: None. This edition contains no photographs, no generated images and no assets taken from any reference site. Every graphic is an SVG file written by hand; the hour rules, the track tints and the dashed break bands are CSS.

fonts.origin: @fontsource-variable/space-grotesk, latin subset with the weight axis. Used for display, headings, labels and every time on the site, with tabular figures throughout
@fontsource-variable/inter, latin subset with the weight axis, copied from public/templates/_plotform-fonts. Used for running text only

referenceDirection: A congress read as a timetable rather than as a brochure: a warm paper ground, a near black ink, three track colours that key the grid and the pages alike, a compressed grotesk for display and for every time, hairline hour rules, and drawings instead of photographs. No reference site code, imagery or branding copied.
demoContent: Plenum, its dates, its venue, its six rooms, its thirty sessions and its twelve speakers are illustrative examples, not a real congress and not real people. No ticket prices, attendance figures, sponsors, awards or testimonials appear anywhere, and no form, booking flow or map service is wired to anything.
